people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul

people.name: Ahitub
people.line: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
translations.bsb: But one of the sons of Ahimelech son of Ahitub escaped. His name was Abiathar, and he fled to David.
translations.kjv: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
translations.asv: And one of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
